tuition_model.notes: Under reciprocal bilateral exchange agreements, incoming exchange students continue paying tuition to their home institution and receive an instructional tuition waiver at CofC.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory CofC LewerMark health insurance billed to student account: $600/semester in AY 2026-2027/2027 sheet (was $522 Fall 2025 / $490 Spring 2026; https://lewermark.com/school/cofc/).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/College of Charleston/2026-2027/Charleston Partner Information Sheet 2027.pdf#page=2
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Prior AY rates ($522 Fall / $490 Spring) noted in Charleston Partner Information Sheet 2026-2027.pdf#page=2.

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/College of Charleston/2026-2027/Charleston Partner Information Sheet 2027.pdf#page=2
housing_availability.notes: CofC usually honors all on-campus housing requests for incoming exchange students if submitted by the housing deadline (May 1 for Fall; Nov 1 for Spring), but not formally guaranteed.

housing_notes.value: Apply via https://charleston.edu/housing/ (deadlines: May 1 Fall, Nov 1 Spring). Estimated Room & Board: $7,259/semester (AY 2026-2027/2027 sheet; also lists $3,444 personal/transport and $780 books/supplies per semester).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/College of Charleston/2026-2027/Charleston Partner Information Sheet 2027.pdf#page=2

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 visa via Form DS-2019 issued by Center for International Education (CIE) after post-admission upload of Certificate of Finances and supporting bank statements/proof of funding covering living expenses ($12,083/sem total estimated Room & Board, personal/transport, books, and $600 insurance in 2027 sheet).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/College of Charleston/2026-2027/Charleston Partner Information Sheet 2027.pdf#page=2

course_restrictions_note.value: All undergraduate academic areas open except School of Business restrictions: HTMT 488 and all ACCT courses other than ACCT 203 and ACCT 204 are closed; ECON 400, FINC 400, FINC 418, and MGMT 408 are evaluated case-by-case.

academic_style.value: Public liberal arts and sciences university (>10,000 students, >100 areas of study) emphasizing small-to-medium undergraduate classes in historic downtown Charleston.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/College of Charleston/2026-2027/Charleston Partner Information Sheet 2027.pdf#page=1

campus_type.notes: Fact sheet p. 1 explicitly states campus is 'located in the historic downtown' of Charleston (~130,000 residents).

international_support_services.value: Cougar Ambassador Buddy Program, free Charleston (CHS) airport pickup on arrival day, virtual and in-person orientation, International Club, and monthly coffee hours/grocery trips.
